articles.title: Meat Shop Forced Shut in Ghaziabad: Man Threatens to Set Store on Fire Over Tuesday Sale Near Temple
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension prevailed in Kaila Bhatta village under Kotwali police station limits after a man allegedly forced an elderly shopkeeper to shut his mutton shop, threatening to set it on fire if it remained open on a Tuesday.

body.html:
Tension prevailed in Kaila Bhatta village under Kotwali police station limits after a man allegedly forced an elderly shopkeeper to shut his mutton shop, threatening to set it on fire if it remained open on a Tuesday.

The accused has been identified as Satyam Pandit, who claims to be associated with the Rashtriya Hindu Veer Sena. The incident reportedly occurred on Tuesday, February 24.

Threats Caught on Video

A video of the incident was shared by Pandit on his Facebook account on February 25. In the clip, he is seen confronting the shop owner and asking whether they had “permission” to sell meat on Mangalwar (Tuesday). He is heard telling the shopkeeper to close the shop immediately, citing the presence of a nearby temple.

He allegedly warned, “If the shop is seen open on Tuesday again, I will set it on fire in a minute.”

Following the confrontation, the shopkeeper and his staff complied and moved their business inside.

In the caption accompanying the video, Pandit wrote that meat shops would not be allowed to operate in Ghaziabad on Tuesdays and claimed that they had got shops in Kaila Bhatta closed.

Police Response

The Station House Officer of Kotwali police station stated that the matter came to their notice through social media.

“We received information about the incident from social media. Officers are on the field inspecting the situation. We are awaiting more information,” the SHO said, adding that no case has been registered so far and investigation is underway.

The incident has sparked debate over vigilantism and enforcement of self-imposed restrictions on businesses.

articles.title: CT University VC Removed After Ramadan Row Involving Kashmiri Students
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Vice-Chancellor of CT University in Ludhiana, Dr Nitin Tandon, has been removed from his position following a controversy involving Kashmiri Muslim students over alleged misconduct during Ramadan.

body.html:
The Vice-Chancellor of CT University in Ludhiana, Dr Nitin Tandon, has been removed from his position following a controversy involving Kashmiri Muslim students over alleged misconduct during Ramadan.

The issue arose after a group of Kashmiri students protested, claiming that the university mess failed to provide proper arrangements for Sehri (pre-dawn meal) and Iftar (fast-breaking meal). According to the students, when they approached the administration seeking special meal arrangements, the Vice-Chancellor allegedly used abusive language and threatened to cancel their admissions and evict them from the hostel. A video of the purported exchange surfaced on social media and quickly went viral.

The matter escalated after Iltija Mufti, daughter of former Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Mehbooba Mufti, shared the video online and tagged Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, demanding strict action. The Jammu and Kashmir Students Association (JKSA) also formally sought the intervention of the Punjab government.

Amid mounting public pressure and administrative scrutiny, the university management terminated Dr Tandon’s services on February 24, 2026.

The Ludhiana district administration, including the Deputy Commissioner and the Shahi Imam, intervened to mediate between the students and the university authorities. A high-level inquiry has been ordered, headed by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) of Jagraon, to examine allegations of administrative failure and misconduct.

In the interim, Pro Vice-Chancellor Simran Gill has assumed charge of the Vice-Chancellor’s responsibilities. Further proceedings will depend on the outcome of the inquiry.

articles.title: Love Triangle Turns Bloody in Meerut: Husband Shoots Wife’s Live-in Partner, Issues Open Threat
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sensational daylight murder in Meerut triggered outrage after the accused husband shot dead his wife’s alleged live-in partner in full public view and later released a chilling self-confession video.

body.html:
A sensational daylight murder in Meerut triggered outrage after the accused husband shot dead his wife’s alleged live-in partner in full public view and later released a chilling self-confession video.

Daylight Murder Caught on CCTV:
The incident occurred around 1:45 pm on Wednesday in the Ramraj area under Bahsuma police station limits. Surendra alias Sunil was riding his motorcycle when Pradeep, a resident of Sanota, arrived on another bike with his face covered in cloth.

Pradeep allegedly fired three shots in quick succession. The first bullet hit Surendra from behind, while subsequent shots struck his head and temple, killing him on the spot. CCTV footage (39 seconds) shows the accused arriving, firing, shouting in the market, and fleeing fearlessly.

Police investigations revealed that Surendra was allegedly in a relationship with Pradeep’s wife, who had left her husband about one-and-a-half years ago and was living with Surendra.

Road Blockade by Family:
After post-mortem, the body was handed over to the family on Thursday. Angry relatives placed the body on the road and blocked traffic, causing long jams on both sides. They demanded immediate arrest of the accused and security for the family, alleging that he was roaming freely.

Police officials reached the spot and pacified the family. The accused, Pradeep, was later arrested near Kalavada canal in the Falavada police station area. Multiple police teams were involved in the operation.

Viral Confession & Open Threat:
In a separate four-minute video, Pradeep filmed himself while riding a motorcycle, confessing to the murder. He claimed sole responsibility, displayed a pistol tucked in his waistband, and threatened to kill his wife as well.

He alleged harassment over the past one-and-a-half years and accused certain police officials of inaction. He also claimed he would dispose of the weapon in a canal and openly challenged the administration.

Police Action:
Rural SP Abhijeet Kumar confirmed that a case has been registered and further legal action is underway. Forensic teams examined the crime scene, and additional forces were deployed to maintain law and order due to rising tension in the area.

The brutal act, captured on camera and followed by an open threat on social media, has left the region shocked and raised serious questions about public safety and law enforcement response.

articles.title: Stepmother Allegedly Hacks 3-Year-Old to Death in Gorakhpur, Arrested After Villagers Chase Her Down
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has been reported from Bijhara village under Pipraich area in Gorakhpur, where a woman allegedly killed her three-year-old stepdaughter with an axe late Tuesday night (24 Feb 2026).

body.html:
A shocking incident has been reported from Bijhara village under Pipraich area in Gorakhpur, where a woman allegedly killed her three-year-old stepdaughter with an axe late Tuesday night (24 Feb 2026).

According to police, the accused, Pooja (35), allegedly threw the sleeping child, Aditi, to the ground and then attacked her neck with an axe, killing her on the spot. Blood reportedly splattered across the room, staining the walls.

The child’s father, Triveni Maurya (40), said he had stepped outside to urinate when the incident occurred. “When I returned, I saw my daughter lying in blood. I screamed. I could not believe someone could do this to such a small child,” he said.

On seeing him, the accused allegedly attempted to flee. Triveni chased her, shouting for help. Villagers joined the pursuit and caught her nearly one kilometre away. Her hands and feet were tied with a rope before she was handed over to police.

When questioned by locals, the woman allegedly stated that her husband loved his daughter more and she wanted to “teach him a lesson.”

Triveni had married Laxmi in 2012, and the couple had Aditi. After Laxmi’s death two years ago, he married Pooja about a month ago. The three had been living together in the village house.

On receiving information, Pipraich station in-charge Atul Kumar Srivastava reached the spot with a police team. The accused was arrested, and the axe used in the crime was recovered on her indication. The child’s body has been sent for postmortem examination.

Police said further investigation is underway and strict legal action will be taken against the accused.

articles.title: “Justice for Prakhar”: PSIT Student’s Death Sparks Protest in Kanpur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension gripped Kanpur after a final-year BCA student of Pranveer Singh Institute of Technology (PSIT) died following a collision with a JCB during ongoing construction work. Students staged protests on campus, raising slogans of “Justice for Prakhar” and alleging negligence.

body.html:
Tension gripped Kanpur after a final-year BCA student of Pranveer Singh Institute of Technology (PSIT) died following a collision with a JCB during ongoing construction work. Students staged protests on campus, raising slogans of “Justice for Prakhar” and alleging negligence.

The deceased, Prakhar Singh (21), son of fertilizer businessman Prabhakar Singh of Ratanlal Nagar, was a final-year BCA student. According to family members, he left for college as usual on Monday. Around 5 pm, while exiting through the rear gate of the campus in Sachendi, he allegedly collided with a stationary JCB amid heavy dust caused by a speeding car passing in front of him.

Relatives claimed that construction work had been underway on campus without adequate safety arrangements. Due to poor visibility caused by dust, Prakhar reportedly lost control of his bike and rammed into the machine. The impact severely damaged his kidneys, lungs and pancreas.

He was initially taken to a hospital in Kalyanpur and later shifted to Regency Hospital in Sarvodaya Nagar, where doctors declared him dead around 2 am.

Students alleged that the accident occurred due to lack of safety measures during construction inside the campus. However, PSIT Group Director Prof. Manmohan Shukla denied that the incident took place within the campus premises, stating that the accident occurred about 200 metres away from the college.

Police personnel were deployed on campus to control the situation as protests continued. Further investigation is underway.

#Kanpur #PSIT #JusticeForPrakhar #StudentProtest #CampusSafety #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews

articles.title: BJP MLA’s Son Caught on CCTV Slapping Toll Worker in Agra After FASTag Row
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing the son of a BJP MLA allegedly slapping a toll worker at Raibha Toll Plaza in Agra has surfaced on social media, triggering controversy.

body.html:
A video showing the son of a BJP MLA allegedly slapping a toll worker at Raibha Toll Plaza in Agra has surfaced on social media, triggering controversy.

The incident took place on Tuesday afternoon when Suresh Chaudhary, son of Chaudhary Babulal, MLA from Fatehpur Sikri, was travelling in a car marked “MLA” from Mathura to Gwalior.

According to toll authorities, the vehicle did not have a FASTag. Despite displaying a VIP/assembly sticker, the barrier was not opened for nearly two minutes, leading to an argument between Suresh and the toll staff.

CCTV footage from the plaza shows Suresh stepping out of the car and allegedly slapping toll worker Sanjay Singh, a resident of Daureta in Agra, twice. As he began returning to his vehicle, he suddenly turned back and attempted to approach the worker again but was restrained by other toll employees. It is reported that his wife and children were present in the car during the incident.

The toll worker alleged that since the vehicle bore a Mathura (UP-85) registration number and lacked FASTag, he asked for Aadhaar identification for verification. He claimed the request led to verbal abuse and physical assault.

Toll Manager Ishwar Sharma confirmed that the vehicle did not have FASTag and that staff sought Aadhaar verification, which triggered the altercation.

Meanwhile, MLA Chaudhary Babulal defended his son, alleging that the toll employee misbehaved first. He claimed that Suresh introduced himself, informed staff about the assembly sticker, and attempted to connect them over a phone call, but they refused. The MLA termed the viral video a conspiracy by political opponents and questioned how common citizens are treated if an elected representative faces such behaviour.

No official statement regarding legal action had been issued at the time of reporting.

articles.title: Bride Shot on Stage During Varmala in Buxar; Rejected Lover Suspected, Groom Returns Without Wedding
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A wedding celebration in Buxar turned into a scene of horror on Tuesday (24 Feb 2026) night when an 18-year-old bride was shot on stage during the varmala ceremony, allegedly by a youth said to be her rejected lover. The accused fled immediately after the firing.

body.html:
A wedding celebration in Buxar turned into a scene of horror on Tuesday (24 Feb 2026) night when an 18-year-old bride was shot on stage during the varmala ceremony, allegedly by a youth said to be her rejected lover. The accused fled immediately after the firing.

The incident occurred in Mallah Tola under Nagar Chausa Panchayat in the Muffasil police station area. The injured bride, Aarti, was first taken to Sadar Hospital in Buxar and later referred to Varanasi due to her critical condition. She is currently undergoing surgery.

The wedding procession had arrived from Sulemanpur village in Ballia district of Uttar Pradesh. Guests were celebrating as the Jaymala ceremony began. According to eyewitnesses and a video from the venue, a masked युवक entered the gathering, moved towards the stage and shot the bride at close range while rituals were underway. The bullet struck her in the stomach. Owing to loud music, the gunshot initially went unnoticed, but panic erupted when she collapsed on stage.

While being rushed to hospital, Aarti reportedly stated that “Dinbandhu shot me,” pointing to her wound.

The accused, identified as Dinbandhu, is said to be a neighbour of the bride. Her family alleged that he harboured one-sided feelings for her, which she did not reciprocate. Her father said there was no question of marriage between them.

However, some locals claimed the two had allegedly been in a relationship for nearly two years and that a previous marriage proposal had fallen through after the accused allegedly contacted the groom’s family.

Police have detained the accused’s father, Ramashankar Chaudhary, for questioning. He denied knowledge of any such relationship. The accused’s house has been sealed, and continuous raids are underway to arrest him.

Station House Officer Chandan Kumar described the case as prima facie linked to a love affair. The groom and his family returned without completing the marriage ceremony.

Further investigation is in progress.

articles.title: GRP Constable Accused of Assaulting Vendor at Mathura Station; Victim Alleges Humiliation
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An alleged assault by a Government Railway Police (GRP) constable at Mathura Junction Railway Station has sparked outrage after a tea vendor claimed he was beaten over a minor issue. The incident reportedly took place on Platform No. 8.

body.html:
An alleged assault by a Government Railway Police (GRP) constable at Mathura Junction Railway Station has sparked outrage after a tea vendor claimed he was beaten over a minor issue.

The incident reportedly took place on Platform No. 8. According to eyewitnesses, GRP constable Suraj Chauhan asked a vendor, Indra, who operates a stall named “Krishna Food,” to prepare tea. Indra allegedly replied that he would serve it after the departure of an incoming train.

Following this, the constable is accused of losing his temper, verbally abusing the vendor and physically assaulting him. While the vendor sustained minor injuries, he has claimed that the incident caused severe mental distress.

Indra stated that the alleged assault was an attack on his dignity and self-respect. Since the incident, he has reportedly been in a state of shock and has threatened to take drastic step, creating tension at the station premises.

The episode has raised concerns over the conduct of security personnel at public places. Local vendors and residents have demanded a high-level inquiry and strict action against the accused constable.

No official statement from the GRP authorities had been issued at the time of reporting. Further investigation is awaited.

(Incident reportedly occurred according to CCTV 25 Feb 2026)
